name: Exp_ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle_MMRec_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on the Schaff JJRSX Trend Cycle indicator, a double-smoothed stochastic-type oscillator that identifies trend cycle reversals. It uses a duplex (dual-direction) money management recommendation system to determine position sizing and trade direction. The EA opens buy trades on bullish cycle reversals from oversold zones and sell trades on bearish reversals from overbought zones.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Schaff JJRSX趋势周期指标进行交易，该指标是一种双重平滑的随机振荡器，用于识别趋势周期反转。它使用双工（双向）资金管理推荐系统来确定仓位大小和交易方向。EA在超卖区域的看涨周期反转时开多单，在超买区域的看跌周期反转时开空单。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff JJRSX趋势周期指标，这是Schaff趋势周期指标的变体，结合了JJRSX（Juerk Jurik相对强弱指数）的平滑算法，产生0-100之间的振荡值来识别趋势方向和周期反转点。入场条件为：当指标从超卖区域（通常低于20-25）向上反转时开多单，当指标从超买区域（通常高于75-80）向下反转时开空单。出场条件依赖于趋势周期指标的再次反转信号或交叉零线，也可能包含止损和止盈设置。仓位管理采用Duplex（双工）资金管理推荐系统，意味着双向交易信号同时带有仓位大小建议，可能根据信号强度或账户权益动态调整手数。资金管理方面，MMRec（Money Management Recommendation）表明该EA集成了资金管理建议模块，可能根据风险百分比或固定比例计算最优仓位大小，而Duplex则暗示系统同时为多空两个方向提供独立的资金管理计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff JJRSX Trend Cycle indicator, a variant of the Schaff Trend Cycle that incorporates the JJRSX (Juerk Jurik Relative Strength Index) smoothing algorithm, producing oscillator values between 0-100 to identify trend direction and cycle reversal points. Entry conditions are: open buy trades when the indicator reverses upward from oversold zones (typically below 20-25), and open sell trades when the indicator reverses downward from overbought zones (typically above 75-80). Exit conditions rely on the trend cycle indicator issuing another reversal signal or crossing its midpoint, and may also include stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing employs a Duplex (dual-direction) money management recommendation system, meaning bidirectional trade signals come with position size suggestions, potentially adjusting lot sizes dynamically based on signal strength or account equity. For money management, MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) indicates the EA integrates a money management advisory module, likely calculating optimal position sizes based on risk percentage or fixed fractional methods, while Duplex implies the system provides independent money management calculations for both long and short directions simultaneously.

parameters.name: MM_Mode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式选择（1=固定手数,2=风险百分比）

pros: Schaff趋势周期指标结合JJRSX平滑算法，相比传统RSI或MACD能更快速地捕捉趋势反转信号，减少滞后性
Duplex双工资金管理推荐系统为多空两个方向提供独立计算，使得双向交易的仓位管理更加精细化和灵活
趋势周期类振荡器在震荡市中表现优于趋势跟踪指标，适合识别短期均值回归机会
JJRSX的Jurik平滑算法在保持信号灵敏度的同时有效降低价格噪音干扰
pros_en: The Schaff Trend Cycle combined with JJRSX smoothing captures trend reversals faster than traditional RSI or MACD, reducing lag significantly
The Duplex money management recommendation system provides independent calculations for long and short directions, enabling more refined and flexible position sizing for bidirectional trading
Trend cycle oscillators outperform trend-following indicators in ranging markets, making them well-suited for identifying short-term mean reversion opportunities
The JJRSX Jurik smoothing algorithm effectively reduces price noise while maintaining signal sensitivity
cons: 趋势周期振荡器在强趋势市场中容易产生频繁的虚假反转信号，导致连续亏损
Duplex资金管理系统如果缺乏足够的风险控制机制，可能在双向信号同时触发时导致过度仓位暴露
依赖单一指标（Schaff JJRSX趋势周期）作为交易信号源，缺乏多维度确认机制，增加了假信号风险
没有明确的新K线检查机制可能导致同一信号周期内重复开仓
cons_en: Trend cycle oscillators tend to generate frequent false reversal signals in strong trending markets, leading to consecutive losses
The Duplex money management system, without sufficient risk controls, may cause excessive position exposure when bidirectional signals trigger simultaneously
Relying on a single indicator (Schaff JJRSX Trend Cycle) as the sole signal source lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, increasing the risk of false signals
Absence of explicit new bar checking mechanisms may lead to repeated position openings within the same signal period
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如要求高一级时间框架趋势方向与信号一致才开仓，以过滤低质量信号
添加最大同时持仓限制和账户风险暴露上限检查，防止Duplex双向信号同时触发时过度加仓
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring the higher timeframe trend direction to align with the signal before opening positions, to filter out low-quality signals
Implement maximum simultaneous position limits and account risk exposure caps to prevent over-leveraging when Duplex bidirectional signals trigger simultaneously

risk_points: 单一指标依赖在趋势市中易产生连续虚假反转信号导致连续亏损
Duplex双向资金管理在极端行情下可能导致双向同时持仓增加风险暴露
默认止损止盈为0意味着出场完全依赖指标反转信号，可能造成较大单笔亏损
risk_points_en: Single indicator dependency prone to consecutive false reversal signals in trending markets, leading to repeated losses
Duplex bidirectional money management may increase risk exposure with simultaneous long and short positions during extreme market conditions
Default stop-loss and take-profit of 0 means exits rely entirely on indicator reversal signals, potentially causing large per-trade losses
